tools.name: get_my_membership
tools.title: Get my membership
tools.description: Get the signed-in member's Storm Wellness Club membership status, tier, billing dates and past-due flag.

tools.name: list_my_credits
tools.title: List my credits
tools.description: List the signed-in member's remaining wellness and class credits for the current billing cycle, with expiry dates.

tools.name: list_my_class_bookings
tools.title: List my class bookings
tools.description: List the signed-in member's class bookings with session date, time and class name. Defaults to upcoming bookings.

include_past.description: Include bookings for sessions that already happened. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum bookings to return. Defaults to 20, max 100.

tools.name: list_upcoming_classes
tools.title: List upcoming classes
tools.description: List upcoming Storm Wellness Club class sessions with date, time, class name and remaining spots. Booking opens 4 weeks out.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to look. Defaults to 14, max 28.

category.description: Optional class category filter, e.g. pilates or cycling.

only_available.description: Only return sessions with open spots. Defaults to false.

tools.name: list_my_spa_appointments
tools.title: List my spa appointments
tools.description: List the signed-in member's spa and recovery appointments with service, date, time and status. Defaults to upcoming.

include_past.description: Include past appointments. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum appointments to return. Defaults to 20, max 100.

tools.name: list_spa_services
tools.title: List spa services
tools.description: List active Storm Wellness Club spa and recovery services with duration, standard price and member price.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. massage or recovery.
